notes.title: Devilguard - new game announcement and demo release!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, adventure lovers![/h2]

The Devilguard demo is available for download on Steam, which will allow you to form first impressions of the project, which in turn will help me make the game much better!

[previewyoutube=PpJYQkqS46Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Devilguard is a 2D action adventure game with dynamic combat, non-linear levels, exploration and an engaging story. Adventure awaits!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950650/Devilguard/]Add Devilguard your wishlist and try the demo![/url]

Please feel free to leave your feedback and report bugs in community hub, in private messages, via e-mail, whatever.

[h3]Have a nice game![/h3]

notes.title: Just In Time For Halloween, Spooky Mystery Whodunit Is Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/bfafed816a6a7903571576b1dcf456bb986b04af.png[/img]

[b]Put your detective hat on and solve the untimely murder of a famous video game designer.[/b]

A fabulously wealthy game designer is found dead outside his castle in rural Vermont, and soon evidence shows that this was not merely a freak accident attributed to local superstition. Now it's up to you to investigate the murder and apprehend the guilty. Play as unlikely partners -- ace sleuth Detective Guy and Cleo, the clue-sniffing dog to explore the castle grounds, search for clues, and question suspects. Can you solve the case?
[list]
[*] Murder mystery whodunit
[*] Play as a detective and dog crime-solving team
[*] Explore the area and look for clues
[*] Interview suspects and make deductions
[*] Solve the case and apprehend the guilty
[/list]
“I’m excited to share “Murder Is Game Over” with gamers and mystery fans everywhere. I hope players enjoy the exploration mechanics, spooky atmosphere, and classically-inspired whodunit story,” said Matthew of HitherYon Games. 

[b]Murder Is Game Over[/b] is 20% off until November 1. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940090/Murder_Is_Game_Over

notes.title: The Guise - new game announcement
notes.content:
[h1][b]Become the monster![/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154680/The_Guise/
[previewyoutube=iRXud0F7qQo;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154680/The_Guise/]Add to your wishlist[/url]

The main character is an ordinary boy turned into a monster. You are about to adapt to the abilities of your new body and try to hold on to what makes you human. From now on, animal agility, monstrous strength and unique abilities will be on your side, but all the living and the dead things will turn against you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28973723/cdf820a50c4ca0e7886ae0adf5150feffc670a8a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28973723/e8f2f914ded415473e712a3e66ba8a2e6900c6d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28973723/65ffe7fb6855f21795e218aa4b4113fbac3f7a84.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28973723/aa68d9ca8c3b22ee6e5fd1be26b7e5a908b596e4.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Forget the glorious images of video game heroes and become the disgusting monster.
[*]Use your monstrous abilities, run on the ceiling and drop to the enemies heads, spray the acid and bile bombs straight from your stomach.
[*]Evolve by taking unique abilities away from the bosses.
[*]Explore the interconnected ways of the big world that filled with an atmosphere of doom and decay.
[*]Collect the enemies eyes to improve your abilities, find the secrets and hiding places, meet the weird NPCs and step by step discover the gaming world.
[/list]

Planned release date: Spring. 2020.

notes.title: UltraGoodness 2 is on the way!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1136070/UltraGoodness_2/]UltraGoodness 2[/url] will be released in two weeks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1136070/UltraGoodness_2

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y_EDPhANpUA&feature=youtu.be
UltraGoodness 2 is still a fun and bloody action game, but this time it blended with the time manipulation and availability of permanent companion cat. 
[list]
[*]Special time-motion mechanic: time moves slower when the player doesn’t move or shoot.
[*]Permanent companion: flurry white cat who can fight demons as well as you do.
[*]Fast-paced (when you're moving or shooting) gameplay: kill enemies and maneuver through a hurricane of fireballs! Or stop and think how to dodge the bullets that are headed straight for your face.
[*]Against you – the Satan's forces, deadly traps and challenging bosses.
[*]Upgrade your companion cat: let him burn your enemies or fry their brains by laser.
[*]Finally, the main thing about UltraGoodness 2 is having fun, so turn off your brain and splatter the blood all over the levels.
[/list]
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/11Bwvq9AT6tACj2vOK/giphy.gif]

notes.title: UltraGoodness is on the way!
notes.content:
[h1]UltraGoodness is on the way! Be ready to kick some pixel asses today![/h1]
https://youtu.be/0IUO82y7eQs
"UltraGoodness" is a bloody mess, dynamic and fun action about the struggle between Good and Evil in the world, where the Dark Forces turned all creatures into possessed monsters. Tear your enemies to pieces, leave oceans of blood and mountains of corpses! Kill poor little animals, fricking terrorists and ghoulish-like creatures. Fight the Evil using its methods, show 'em what you got, show 'em your RAGE! But remember – it's all in the name of Goodness, of course!

[list][*]Fast-paced gameplay: kill poor creatures and try not to die too fast!
[*]You are in the League of Goodness, dude: there are some brutal characters with the biggest nuts at your disposal, each has its own skill, guns and the powerful spells.
[*]Against you – there is a fricking army of psychos, deadly traps, voracious demons and challenging bosses!
[*]It sucks to fight with the whole mess alone, right? Find a random companion and the power-ups: burn or freeze your enemies, sic your cute pug on them, call the dreadful ghost (in fact he is nice) to grind their bones into the dust!
[*]Splatter blood all over the levels, you fucking maniac!
[*]Music? There is some music in the game… watch your ears!
[/list]
